target_customer: Engineering and finance teams that use AI for data work and need output audited against source files
problem: AI tools return confident wrong numbers, which is costly in engineering and finance. Energent runs an independent audit agent that checks output against the original documents.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for an AI data agent with an audit layer (earlier products: open source Uniflow and the AnyParser API, usage priced)
product_category: AI data work agent and document parsing

founders.name: Rachel Hu
education: UC Berkeley (alum, per YC listing as relayed by a search result)
founders.background_notes: Led open source D2L.ai at AWS per YC page. Education line is from a search snippet of the YC page, not opened directly, so low weight.

founders.name: Kimi Kong
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Kimi as co-founder and a launch post calls him a hardware engineer; the YC Uniflow launch post names a co-founder as Jojo, so the nickname is unresolved.

technical_complexity.rationale: Document layout models and vision language parsing needed ML research skill, later followed by agentic audit systems.

defensibility.rationale: Document parsing and general AI agents were quickly commoditized by large model vendors and funded rivals; accuracy claims are self reported.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from sources; the company shifted from parsing to a data work agent with an audit angle.

market_need_then: Developers building LLM pipelines struggled with accurate PDF parsing in 2023, per the company launch post ('existing PDF parsers' struggle with accuracy).

branding.domain_note: Uses energent.ai; earlier brand CambioML used cambioml.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct warning tone: 'Catch AI hallucinations before they cost you.'

rebrands.why: Not stated; sources describe Energent.ai as a product of CambioML, so a full rename is unconfirmed

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search found only launch pages in many languages, no press on the brand; two names (CambioML, Energent.ai) split attention and Energent.ai is easily confused with Energi.ai.

pivots.from: Open source Uniflow and AnyParser document parsing (CambioML)
pivots.to: Energent.ai desktop AI teammate with an audit agent
pivots.why: Not stated by a source; dates unknown

outcome_analysis: Energent.ai is an active successor to the CambioML document parsing company, now selling an AI data agent with an independent audit layer. The company site claims a leaderboard win and large customer counts that are not independently confirmed. No primary funding source was found, so the capital behind the pivot is unknown.
notes: Aggregators put total raised at $500K to $568K for CambioML with various investors (Z Venture Capital, Gaingels, General Catalyst, Embedding VC, Samsung NEXT, Hub71); single-source, so not recorded as rounds. A $3M Cambio seed in Feb 2024 found on startupintros is a different company (debt negotiation bots) and excluded. Competitors named in searches were undated, so the list is empty. YC pages exist under both cambioml and energent-ai slugs. Claims such as 100,000+ clients and 10x accuracy are company or vendor-adjacent claims.
